description: Bicycle Counts is a dataset listed in City of Toronto open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by City of Toronto. Two separate data sets are available: 1\. Ongoing intersections counts: these are cyclist counts that have been gathered at intersections in order to measure the amount of cycling traffic at certain locations. These counts are typically done using automatic bike counters or by manual count. This dataset is continually updated as additional counts are completed. Coverage: Toronto. The portal files it under the publisher City of Toronto. Its tags are bicycles, bike lanes, cycling. It offers 4 resource(s) in SHP, XLSX, ZIP. The portal shows 2025-07-24 as the last update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is open-government-licence-toronto. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support cycling and walking network and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-am-toronto-portal.
